answer: Repeated sybil identities pay the full bond plus escalating challenge fees each epoch, while honest agents recover stake at the horizon of two clean epochs. Each agent must post a bonded stake and solve a rotating beacon challenge tied to its history; identities that never transact leave a hollow on-chain record. Faking a thousand identities costs a thousand bonds and a thousand beacon solutions, making forgery economically irrational. In practice, sa0024 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
